name: unit_symbols
description: Render measurement unit names as standard case-sensitive symbols, without numerical conversion; matched control copies the measured object's name.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
units={'kilogram':'kg','centimeter':'cm','millimeter':'mm','kilometer':'km','milligram':'mg','hertz':'Hz','kilohertz':'kHz','megahertz':'MHz','pascal':'Pa','kilopascal':'kPa','joule':'J','watt':'W','volt':'V','ampere':'A','kelvin':'K','meter':'m'}
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(96):
 unit=list(units)[i%len(units)]; obj=random.choice(['sample','device','component','material','specimen','object']); tag=random.choice(['A','B','C','D'])
 context='For '+obj+' '+tag+', a measurement is reported in '+unit+' units. '
 items.append({'prompt':context+'Write only the standard unit symbol, preserving capitalization.\nSymbol:','answer':' '+units[unit]})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'Write only the label letter of the measured object.\nLabel:','answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
